steps: 1. Enable Bot Behavior Improvements and its hazard-resistance option, then expose a bot to several consecutive gas hits.
2. Keep that bot clear of gas for more than two seconds, expose it again, and repeat both steps with warpfire.
3. Separately place a shield-using bot under Ratling Gunner fire and retain the resulting host log and its bounded `[gt:488]` rows.
assertions: Gas and warpfire each ramp through five resistance stacks independently, and the first hit after more than two seconds clear is unmitigated. The Ratling encounter records a bounded observation without changing bot behavior. The complete regression report finishes with every expected check passing and no failures.
Harness: apply six gas then six warpfire hits to a bot, read mitigation receipts 0/20/40/60/80/100 percent per hazard, reset after 2 s clear.
